scope: Milngin Darwin early-voting closing-hour correction and conflicting summary opening date only; unchanged candidate and other deadline provenance is preserved.
method: Read official web-source HTML bodies and the currently linked detailed programme on 28 November. The retrieved copies have the individual crawl ages below; they are not fresh native-origin responses. No search snippet is the sole support for the changed closing hour.

sources.supports: Darwin early voting 30 November through 2 December, 8:30 am to 4 pm. Overseas/local postal application cutoffs are separately named as 29 November/1 December at 6 pm. Postal completion is before 3 December at 6 pm.

Independent dated release gives Darwin early voting 30 November through 2 December, 8:30 am to 4 pm, and names overseas/local application cutoffs separately. It also repeats the two declared candidates and ballot order; their canonical review dates are not advanced.

The summary now prints 23 November at 8:30 am for early voting, conflicting with the detailed sources. It separately lists mobile voting from 23 November at 9 am, postal dispatch cutoffs and counting from 3 December at 6 pm.

The currently linked detailed timetable text gives 30 November at 8:30 am for early-voting start and 2 December at 4 pm for cessation. Other unchanged dates are corroborative only because visual inspection was unavailable.
sources.limit: The web reader labels this retrieved output as a rewritten summary with PDF text extraction. The screenshot returned cache miss; ordinary native GET returned HTTP 403. The changed closing hour relies independently on both HTML sources.

retainedOpening.summaryConflict: The summary updated 23 November prints 23 November at 8:30 am. Both detailed HTML sources and linked detailed timetable give 30 November at 8:30 am. No claim is made that the discrepancy has been resolved by NTEC.
